home.title: Home
home.empty: All done for today! New cards arrive tomorrow.
home.cardsWaiting: {count, plural, one {card is waiting for review} other {cards are waiting for review}}
home.deckEmpty: The deck is empty — all reviewed
home.deckEmptyText: Words come back as soon as it is time to review them.
home.addWordTip: Found a word you want to learn? Add it to your set right away!
home.addListTitle: Add a list of new words
home.addListTip: Got a ready-made list? Paste it and add all the words at once.
home.libraryTip: Learned almost every word you had? Add new ones from ready-made sets!

install.title: Add VocabX to your home screen
install.text: VocabX is made for regular practice: a few minutes a day, and the words really stick. With a shortcut the app is always at hand, like any other app.
install.howIos: Tap "Share" at the bottom of Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.howAndroid: Open the browser menu (⋮ at the top) and choose "Add to Home screen".
install.comeBack: Your feedback truly matters to us. Coming back tomorrow or the day after gives our statistics an enormous boost: it shows us what helps you learn and what to improve.
install.thanks: Thank you for helping make VocabX better!

enable.title: Game mode is off
enable.text: This button turns on the playful side: your character friend, levels, rewards and the wardrobe. Tap it any time — or turn it on right now.

hello.title: Hi! Let me show you around
hello.text: A quick tour of the home screen — under a minute. You can skip it at any time.

streak.title: Streak and calendar
streak.text: How many days in a row you have met your daily goal. Those days get a flame in the calendar — try not to break the streak.

character.title: This is your friend
character.text: It is happy when you study and sad when you have been away. Tap it and it will tell you something.

message.title: What your friend says
message.text: Here it cheers you on and tells you how much is left to your daily goal.

level.title: Level
level.text: Every answer earns experience (XP), and your level grows with it. Tap to see all levels and their rewards.

goal.title: Daily goal
goal.text: How much XP you want to earn each day. Meet it and the day lights up with a flame in the calendar.

wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
wardrobe.text: Change your friend's look here. New items unlock with levels — the button lights up when they do.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.text: Something unclear, or have an idea? Write to us — we read every message.

deck.title: Your deck
deck.text: The main button: all your words gathered in one deck. Tap it to review the cards that are due right now.

add.title: Add words
add.text: Add a single word with its translation, or paste a whole list — it all goes into your deck.

library.title: Library
library.text: Ready-made word sets by level and topic. Add a whole set or pick words one by one.

pages.home: this screen: streak, goal and your deck.
pages.review: cards with the words that are due.
pages.decks: all your words and decks: search, edit, import a list.
pages.league: compete with other learners. Coming soon.

extras.title: Feedback, language and settings
extras.text: Send us feedback, change the interface language or open the settings: theme, game mode, daily goal and your data.

bye.title: All set!
bye.text: Start with your deck: a few minutes a day and the words really stick. You can repeat this tour in the settings.

gameHello.title: Game mode is on!
gameHello.text: Now you have a character friend, levels and rewards. Let me show you where everything is.

gameBye.title: On to new levels!
gameBye.text: Every review brings a new level — and new things for your friend — a little closer.

review.title: Review
review.intro: A single-window review session: cards, swipes and keyboard shortcuts.

decks.title: Decks
decks.intro: Your own and built-in decks, search and import.

league.title: League
league.intro: A weekly league with demo participants.
